name: read_notifications
description: Read one page of the connected GitHub account notification feed, independently of realtime filters and checkpoints. GET only; never marks read or changes subscriptions. all=true includes read notifications; participating=true restricts to participating/mention notifications according to GitHub. Defaults: unread, account feed, 30 rows. since/before are ISO timestamps. Local whitelist filters are AND across fields, OR within each list; omitted or null fields allow all, empty arrays match none. thread IDs are notification IDs, not issue/PR numbers. A filtered page can be empty and still have next_page. GitHub reason is a thread-level reason and mention may persist on later comments; no direct-reply inference. No comment/body expansion.
